info.title: SharedSpaces.Cli
info.description: SharedSpaces CLI — join spaces and sync files from the command line

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SharedSpaces CLI — join spaces and sync files

commands.name: join
commands.description: Join a space by exchanging a PIN for an access token

options.name: --pin
options.description: PIN code (overrides PIN embedded in URL)

options.name: --display-name
options.description: Display name for the space membership

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: Invite URL or invitation string (serverUrl|pin or serverUrl|spaceId|pin)

commands.name: items
commands.description: List all items in a space

options.name: --space-id
options.description: The ID of the space to list items from

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload a file to a space

options.name: --space-id
options.description: ID of the space to upload to

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the file to upload

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a text message to a space

options.name: --space-id
options.description: ID of the space to send to

arguments.name: MESSAGE
arguments.description: Text to send. Omit or pass '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Sync files from a space to a local folder

options.name: --space-id
options.description: ID of the space to sync from

options.name: --folder
options.description: Path to local folder for synced files

options.name: --passive
options.description: Use periodic journal polling instead of real-time SignalR updates [default: False]

options.name: --interval
options.description: Passive poll interval in seconds (requires --passive). Default: 300, minimum: 5 [default: 300]
